title: 第150章 研究新突破第149章 一个动作拿下种子计划领导权
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
这一点，邱予自然是再同意不过。
夏以苜与他们的目标是一样的，他们也算是志同道合之人。
“对了，我这里有些研究成果，华长老他们都不知道，或许对你来说会有帮助。”邱予上前一步。
邱予毕竟是太上长老，手里的东西的确有含金量。
其中一些内容对夏以苜确实有一定的启发。
“若无其他事，我便先告辞了。”
事情都已经解决，夏以苜这次是真的要离开了。
邱予本还想拉着夏以苜问问她关于改良灵植魔气抵抗性和净化魔气的事情，但终究还是没有开口。
对于他们这样的人来说，最重要的东西便是时间。
而因为他对夏以苜的质疑，已经消耗了她快一日的时间。
思及此，邱予便没有再说什么，想着之后等夏以苜空闲了，总会有时间与她交流的。
在这之前，先与华长老他们交流一番也是好的。
——
夏以苜回到她的研究室中，立即根据邱予给她提供的新思路开始了研究。
此刻她的脑海中又出现了数个方案。
按照那些方案一一试下去，说不定会有所突破。
当她完全沉浸在研究中，时间总是过得很快。
转眼间，一个月的时间过去。
夏以苜卡住了许久的进度终于有所松动。
她成功定位了云冥花净化魔气的关键位置，若是放在现代来说的话，应该是类似于基因的东西。

并且将那东西顺利移植到了微苜的植株中。
可是她能做到的也仅仅只有这样。
经过她的测验，被移植后的微苜并没有出现和云冥花一样的净化魔气的效果。
而且，云冥花净化魔气的原理她如今也没有弄清楚，只是知道了云冥花是靠什么净化魔气的。
这一个月里大部分时间夏以苜都在试着让微苜中净化魔气的“基因”运行起来。
可结果不如人意，能用的方法她都用遍了，微苜依旧无法净化魔气。
进度短暂松动后，又一次被卡住。
而且夏以苜有种感觉，这一次的卡壳可能即便是她也无法冲破。
周围所有的路都被堵死了，除非她能将云冥花净化魔气的原理研究清楚。
再根据这个原理去弄明白“基因”在微苜中为何会失效，不然无论哪一条都是死路。
她将这个结果告知了邱予和华长老他们，并且将移植了云冥花“基因”的微苜分发给他们。
让他们尝试着激活“基因”。
对于这个突破，邱予和华长老等人欣喜若狂。
邱予更是道：“你这一个月的进度已经比得过我百年的研究了。”
之前他还会酸溜溜的，如今已经释然了，这是对夏以苜真心的夸赞。
“那便将这件事交给我们吧，总不好什么事情都让你来做。”华长老说着。
其他长老纷纷附和。
content_en:
Qiu Yu naturally couldn't agree more with this point.
Xia Yihuo has the same goal as them, and they can be regarded as like-minded people.
"By the way, I have some research results here that Elder Hua and the others don't know about. They may be helpful to you." Qiu Yu took a step forward.
Qiu Yu is the Supreme Elder after all, and the things in his hands are indeed valuable.
Some of these contents indeed inspired Xia Yilu.
"If there's nothing else, I'll take my leave first."
The matter has been resolved, and Xia Yihuo is really leaving this time.
Qiu Yu originally wanted to drag Xia Yihuo to ask her about improving the resistance of spiritual plants to demonic energy and purifying the demonic energy, but in the end he did not speak.
For people like them, the most important thing is time.
And because he questioned Xia Yihuo, she had already consumed almost a day.
Thinking of this, Qiu Yu said nothing more, thinking that when Xia Yilu was free, he would always have time to communicate with her.
Before that, it would be good to have some exchanges with Elder Hua and the others.
——
Xia Yimu returned to her research room and immediately started research based on the new ideas Qiu Yu provided her.
At this moment, several more plans appeared in her mind.
If you try those plans one by one, you might be able to achieve a breakthrough.
Time flies when she is completely immersed in research.
In the blink of an eye, a month passed.
Xia Yiluo's progress, which had been stuck for a long time, was finally loosened.
She successfully located the key position of Yun Minghua for purifying demonic energy. If we put it in modern terms, it should be something similar to genes.
And successfully transplanted that thing into the microalfalfa plant.
But that's all she can do.
After her test, the transplanted microclover did not have the same effect of purifying demonic energy as the Yunming flower.
Moreover, she has not yet figured out how Yun Minghua purifies demonic energy. She only knows how Yunminghua purifies demonic energy.
Xia Yilu spent most of this month trying to get the "gene" in Weilu to purify demonic energy to run.
But the result was unsatisfactory. She had tried all possible methods, but the micro-alfalfa still couldn't purify the demonic energy.
After the progress loosened up briefly, it got stuck again.
And Xia Yilu had a feeling that even she might not be able to break through the jam this time.
All the surrounding roads were blocked unless she could clearly study the principle of Yun Minghua's purification of demonic energy.
Then use this principle to figure out why the "gene" fails in microalfalfa, otherwise it will be a dead end no matter what.
She informed Qiu Yu and Elder Hua of the result, and distributed the microclover transplanted with the Yunminghua "gene" to them.
Let them try to activate the "gene".
Qiu Yu, Elder Hua and others were ecstatic about this breakthrough.
Qiu Yu even said: "Your progress this month has already surpassed my hundred years of research."
He was still sour before, but now he is relieved. This is a sincere compliment to Xia Yilu.
"Then leave this matter to us. It's not easy for you to do everything." Elder Hua said.
Other elders agreed.
